jamie: Two quick personal updates for the watercooler: Sam got promoted to Senior SWE and also said yes to Alex this weekend!! double celebration incoming :tada: :ring:
sam: woah thanks y'all!! still processing both. grateful for the team. :blush: we'll celebrate but please no awkward speeches :sweat_smile:
priya: OMG CONGRATS SAMNNN!!! staff vibes + wedding bells :confetti_ball: when do we party?
marco: congrats!!! cake + sparkling water at next week's lunch? also, can someone bring a tiny top hat for Sam's laptop? :top_hat:
liz: super happy for you. can we do a tiny engagement shower in the office? gift card pooling ok?
dana: I can start a Google sheet for a group gift and a sign-up for appetizers. suggested budget $25-50 but totally optional.
jamie: love that. proposal photo incoming later (they're both shy). Sam: any date constraints before you vanish in wedding planning mode?
sam: no hard dates yet, just a bunch of weekend openers. aiming for late summer but TBD. photos later when i stop grinning lol: photo_1772109876_1.jpg
priya: also congrats on the promo!! HR FYI: what title do you want on badge/email? Senior SWE or Staff?
sam: Senior SWE is fine. thank you!! excited to keep shipping with you all.
marco: applause emoji in thread :clap: :clap: :clap:
events-bot: Reminder set: "Sam Celebration" on Tue at 12:30pm in SF kitchen. RSVP by Monday.
priya: i'll handle the card and the sign-up link. any dietary needs? Sam: do you hate gluten? :sweat_smile:
sam: no hate, just a soft spot for donuts.
dana: donuts + mocktails it is. i'll put it on the events calendar and share the sheet.
jamie: thank you everyone. this team is ridiculously wholesome. :heart:
priya: congrats again Sam & Alex!! :heart_eyes:
